name: animclaw
description: Fully Managed OpenClaw Framework for managing your CRM, Sales Automation and Outreach agents. The only local productivity tool you need.
author: Kumar Abhirup <kumar@animclaw.com>, AnimClaw.com <support@animclaw.com>

scripts.deploy:major: set -a && source .env && set +a && bash scripts/deploy.sh --bump major
scripts.deploy:minor: set -a && source .env && set +a && bash scripts/deploy.sh --bump minor
scripts.deploy:patch: set -a && source .env && set +a && bash scripts/deploy.sh --bump patch
scripts.prepack: pnpm build:plugin-env && pnpm build && pnpm web:build && pnpm web:prepack
scripts.test:cli: vitest run --config vitest.unit.config.ts src/cli/run-main.test.ts src/cli/bootstrap-external.test.ts src/cli/bootstrap-external.bootstrap-command.test.ts src/cli/workspace-seed.test.ts src/cli/web-runtime.test.ts src/cli/web-runtime-command.test.ts src/cli/flatten-standalone-deps.test.ts
scripts.web:prepack: cp -r apps/web/public apps/web/.next/standalone/apps/web/public && cp -r apps/web/.next/static apps/web/.next/standalone/apps/web/.next/static && node scripts/flatten-standalone-deps.mjs
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently --kill-others "pnpm --filter animclaw-web dev" "sleep 5 && pnpm --filter animclaw-desktop start"
scripts.desktop:build: pnpm build && pnpm web:build && pnpm web:prepack && pnpm desktop:vendor && pnpm --filter animclaw-desktop make
